simple: Data protection: discovers and classifies sensitive data on servers, computers and cloud storage on its own, keeps an inventory and shows who accessed it, and traces data from creation to deletion. Shows sensitive data on vulnerable systems, detects anomalous access and leaks, and sets rules for how data may move inside the company and leave it; responds by isolating a computer, blocking traffic or revoking access. The endpoint sensor is Data Security for Endpoints. Part of the TrendAI Vision One platform (Trend Micro’s business unit, formerly Trend Vision One); licensed with TrendAI Flex credits that can be reallocated across platform solutions.
